facts.label: Shield Slam (Protection)
facts.value: Shield Slam has 1 rank and sits on row 7, column 2 of the Protection tree. It requires Concussion Blow. In use: 20 Rage, Melee Range, Instant, 6 sec cooldown, Requires Shields.

facts.label: Shield Slam rank 1 of 1
facts.value: Slam the target with your shield, causing 421 to 439 damage, increased by your Block Value, and has a 50% chance of dispelling 1 magic effect on the target. Causes a very high amount of threat.
